name: Production RAG System Evaluation Dataset
description: Comprehensive evaluation dataset for RAG pipeline quality assessment. Covers all DeepEval and RAGAS metric requirements: AnswerRelevancy, Faithfulness, ContextualPrecision, ContextualRecall, Hallucination, ContextPrecision, ContextRecall.

samples.user_input: What is the Ragas framework and what problem does it solve?
samples.expected_output: Ragas (Retrieval Augmented Generation Assessment) is a framework for reference-free evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. It addresses the challenge of evaluating RAG systems across multiple dimensions without requiring ground truth human annotations. RAG systems are composed of a retrieval and an LLM-based generation module, and evaluating them is challenging because there are several dimensions to consider: the ability of the retrieval system to identify relevant and focused context passages, the ability of the LLM to exploit such passages in a faithful way, and the quality of the generation itself. Ragas provides a suite of metrics to evaluate these different dimensions, enabling faster evaluation cycles, which is especially important given the fast adoption of LLMs.
context: We introduce Ragas (Retrieval Augmented Generation Assessment), a framework for reference-free evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.

RAG systems are composed of a retrieval and an LLM based generation module, and provide LLMs with knowledge from a reference textual database, which enables them to act as a natural language layer between a user and textual databases, reducing the risk of hallucinations.

Evaluating RAG architectures is challenging because there are several dimensions to consider: the ability of the retrieval system to identify relevant and focused context passages, the ability of the LLM to exploit such passages in a faithful way, or the quality of the generation itself.
With Ragas, we put forward a suite of metrics which can be used to evaluate these different dimensions without having to rely on ground truth human annotations.
